5.name: the smoke check every prod deploy runs, on this stage: node scripts/stage.ts run psmcp smoke <commit>
5.run: node scripts/stage.ts run psmcp smoke $(git rev-parse HEAD)
5.note: A first run at 17:34 was given the 7-character sha (24f4a01): the script compares the build's 12-character commit with its argument's first 12 characters, so it retried for six minutes ('build 24f4a01a90e6, expected 24f4a01') and failed without reaching the OAuth check. Usage, not a fault: m1-stage-run.md item 5's <commit> must be the full sha (deploy-prod.yml passes it).
